source: lab (captured, real recording; background around the table blurred/replaced, person behind table blurred; 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' watermark bottom-right)

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of background <= 0.1 px over all frames)
camera.view: slightly elevated, looking down onto a table top at a shallow angle; table top recedes away from camera (back edge y~450, front corner y~610)

objects.name: blue_notebook
objects.description: small light-blue (cyan cover) notebook/thin book with white page edges; the only object that moves. Starts lying on the upper end of the white inclined board, slides down it, lands on the table and slides left a little before stopping.
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of full-object mask (cover + page edges) = visible centre

start_rest.note: seen obliquely on the ramp; long axis roughly horizontal in image

end_rest.note: lies flat on table, long axis nearly horizontal in image (~7 deg)

objects.name: white_ramp_board
objects.description: flat white board leaning from table top (lower edge, front-left) up onto the book stack (upper edge, back-right); the notebook slides down it
objects.note: upper corners partly hidden by the notebook in frames 0-18; lower-left corner hidden by notebook in frames 29-34

objects.name: book_stack
objects.description: support under the upper end of the ramp: a dark green/teal hardcover book (bottom) with a lighter thin book on top, right of the ramp
objects.note: left part hidden behind ramp; dark book visible length ~106 px, thickness ~36 px (spine face)

objects.name: table
objects.description: wooden (light brown) square-ish table top on a single dark pedestal

objects.name: person
objects.description: seated person behind/right of the table, heavily blurred (privacy), arm raised near the upper end of the ramp; face region blurred
objects.moves: slightly (arm/hand near the notebook at the start; no clear contact visible)

objects.name: tripod_and_light
objects.description: background tripod (legs x~600-760, y 60-450) with lamp head at (~690,70); bright softbox/light at top centre; dark panel with light at top right

events.event: notebook at rest on top of ramp

events.note: first displacement (~1 px) at frame 19, clear by frame 20 (2.7 px). No visible hand contact; release cause unclear (person blurred)

events.event: front of notebook reaches table / leaves ramp foot
motion end (comes to rest on table)
events.note: frame diff drops at 37; centroid identical 36->48

perspective.ground_plane: table top (horizontal); viewed obliquely from slightly above
perspective.horizon: not directly visible; table edges converge to the right/back
perspective.apparent_size_of_moving_object: notebook long side ~135 px on the ramp (top, frames 0-18), ~147-151 px on table (frames 35-48); mask height drops from ~66 px (seen face-on-ish on ramp) to ~32-37 px (flat on table) because of orientation, not depth. Depth change is small (moves from ~x788 to ~x573, toward the image left and slightly down/forward).

files.tracks/blue_notebook.csv: main per-frame track (full-mask centroid, bbox, extents, cover-only centroid)
files.track_overlay.jpg: trajectory overlay (red = full-mask centroid, blue = cover centroid)
